To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a new online active learning concept for evolving generalized TS fuzzy models in the context of data stream regression.

the combination of evolving generalized TS fuzzy models with our three sample selection criteria is able to achieve an online model update with only 10% to 20% selected samples, which is significantly better than the case when performing the update on all available data, and also much better than the case of random sampling with the same sample size.

the proposed selection concept is based on three criteria: 1) a new homogeneity criterion among local approximators; the uncertainty in model output, which is estimated in terms of local error bars, and the uncertainty in model parameter estimates, which is estimated based on the Fisher information.
